//known-advisory: GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr (low): esbuild 0.27.3-0.28.0 lets any website read files
through the dev server's origin check, on Windows only. It reaches this tree
through tsup, which pins esbuild to ^0.27.0 and so cannot resolve the patched
0.28.1. vite and tsx are already clear of it.
Not overridden, and the reason is worth stating. Forcing the resolution means
regenerating this lockfile, and regenerating it on Windows drops 62 optional
platform binaries that only install on Linux and macOS - the rollup and
napi-rs natives CI needs. `npm ci` on the runner would then fail to find them.
Trading a development-only advisory for a broken pipeline is a bad trade, and
it is the same class of lockfile damage .npmrc already guards against.
Unblocked by either: tsup widening its esbuild range, or regenerating this
lockfile on Linux. Until then `npm audit` reports one low finding and CI gates
at high, which is the honest state of it rather than a suppressed one.
